name: License Flip Audit - BUSL/SSPL/AGPL in your deps
subtitle: Finds the dependencies whose licence changed under you - Terraform 1.6+ BUSL, Redis 7.4+ SSPL, Bitnami's August 2025 move, Elastic 7.11 - and names the exact version where each flip happened.
free: Checks the manifest you have open end to end - every line, all 30 recorded flips, full findings, no watermark and no trial.
paid: Scans every manifest in the workspace, exports the CSV/JSON/HTML report a security review asks for, re-checks on every save, and writes a JSON file CI can fail a pull request on.
need_key: This option needs a licence (License Flip Audit - BUSL/SSPL/AGPL in your deps).
